market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $108 oil, bond selloff (10Y near 5%), and inflation reacceleration. CPI in-line provides brief relief but diesel at $6 and Japan's 7.6% wholesale inflation signal sticky pricing. Expect volatility 15-20% ADR over next 3 months. Fed likely to signal hikes. Oil remains the dominant macro variable.
market_outlook.long_term: If oil sustains $100+ through 2027, inflation becomes entrenched, forcing prolonged tight monetary policy. AI capex cycle (Nvidia, Cloudflare, CoreWeave) provides structural growth offset. Trade wars and geopolitical fragmentation raise baseline risk premium. Consumer squeeze may force Fed to pivot by Q1 2027 if demand destruction accelerates.
